description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the Module class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing the behavior of module extensions, such as loading, expanding, and error handling during extension instantiation.

classes.name: ModuleExtensionsTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class for testing extension loading and error handling within the OpenMRS module framework.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Setup method executed before each test to initialize the Module instance.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Cleanup method to invalidate module class loaders after each test.

methods.name: getExtensions_shouldNotExpandIfExtensionNamesAreNull
methods.description: Test that getExtensions returns an empty list when extension names are null.

methods.name: getExtensions_shouldNotExpandIfExtensionNamesAreEmpty
methods.description: Test that getExtensions returns an empty list when extension names are empty.

methods.name: getExtensions_shouldNotExpandIfNoModuleClassloaderIsFound
methods.description: Test that getExtensions returns an empty list when no module classloader is available for the module.

methods.name: getExtensions_shouldNotFailExpandingAnExtensionNameCausingANoClassDefinitionFoundError
methods.description: Test handling of a missing class during extension expansion, expecting an empty list.

methods.name: getExtensions_shouldNotFailExpandingAClassWhichCannotBeFound
methods.description: Test handling of a class name that does not exist, expecting an empty list.

methods.name: getExtensions_shouldNotFailExpandingAClassWhichCannotBeInstantiated
methods.description: Test handling when extension class cannot be instantiated, expecting an empty list.

methods.name: getExtensions_shouldNotFailExpandingAClassWhichCannotAccessed
methods.description: Test handling access issues during class instantiation, expecting an empty list.

methods.name: getExtensions_shouldExpandClassNamesIntoClassInstances
methods.description: Test that valid extension class names are correctly instantiated as Extension objects.

methods.name: getExtensions_shouldNotExpandAgainIfClassNamesMatch
methods.description: Test that repeated calls without changes keep the same Extension instances.

methods.name: getExtensions_shouldExpandAgainIfExtensionNamesNowHaveADifferentClassOnSameExtensionPoint
methods.description: Test re-expansion when extension name mapping changes.

methods.name: registerModuleClassLoader
methods.description: Helper method that sets up the module's class loader for tests.
